verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents an 'Export Passwords' feature for autofill data, but this covers only saved passwords, not the OTP/account seeds this app is centrally used for; TOTP/account data is only preserved via proprietary encrypted 'Cloud Backup' tied to a Microsoft account, not an open, portable format. Community evidence goes further, describing non-standard QR codes that other TOTP clients reject and users switching to open-source alternatives (Aegis) specifically because Authenticator lacks true open-format export/backup. missing for 10: open-format export of TOTP secrets/accounts, documented data-portability/leave workflow, independent confirmation that exported data works outside Microsoft's ecosystem.
